name: open-ctf-workspace
description: OpenCTF workspace: a CTF toolbox for identifying, unpacking, decoding and patching challenge files on one engine

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt -p open-ctf-core -p open-ctf-napi -- --check && cargo clippy -p open-ctf-core -p open-ctf-napi --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p open-ctf-core -p open-ctf-napi
scripts.gui: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @wae/open-ctf exec node ./dist/cli.js gui
